description: Drive Commerce Customizer helps authorized teams inspect products, options and storefront availability, create and update catalog options, edit product details, and preview and apply promotions between workspaces. Teams can switch workspaces, manage shared catalog notes, refresh caches and ask analytics questions with follow-up reports.
